description: This file implements logging functions for a software project, including setting log file paths, writing log messages with timestamps and optional prefixes, and strip color codes from strings. It contains functions for logging with context such as filename and line number, and manages log file initialization.

methods.name: void UT_log_setLogFilePath(char * inputFilePath)
methods.description: Sets the log file path and name based on the provided directory and current timestamp.

methods.name: void UT_log(const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a message with timestamp, function, and line information to the log file and stdout.

methods.name: void UT_logPrefix(const char * file,int line,const char * prefix,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a message with a prefix, including timestamp, prefix string, filename, and line number.

methods.name: char * UT_stripColorCode(char * in_string)
methods.description: Removes ANSI color codes from a string.

ctags.pattern: /^void UT_log(const char *function, int line, const char * format, ...)$/

ctags.pattern: /^void UT_logPrefix(const char *file, int line, const char *prefix, const char * format, ...)$/
ctags.signature: (const char * file,int line,const char * prefix,const char * format,...)
